OUTPUT ONE SINGLE NEW IMAGE, landscape format, containing ONLY one Victorian horse-drawn carriage on a completely flat solid MAGENTA (#FF00FF) background. Do not reproduce this reference sheet, its three panels, its black gutters or its white captions. Panel C states the output contract; panel A states the style and the light; panel B states the camera and the size.

WHAT: a London HANSOM CAB with its horse in harness. Two tall slender wheels, one on each side, as high as the cab body; between them a small dark closed cab for one or two passengers with a curved roof and low folding front doors; the DRIVER sits high up on a small box seat at the very BACK of the roof in a caped greatcoat and low hat, long reins running forward over the roof; one dark bay horse in the shafts ahead of it. A brass-and-glass carriage lamp burning amber on the near side. The whole thing black and lacquered, the single accent colour the amber of its lamp.

VIEW, from panel B: the carriage is driving AWAY from the viewer up a road that runs off to the upper right, so it is seen FROM BEHIND AND SLIGHTLY TO ITS LEFT and a little from above. About two thirds of its near (left) flank and one third of its back are visible; both left-hand wheels read as clear complete circles; the horse ahead of it is seen from behind, hindquarters and tail plain, its head and neck just showing past the near side of the carriage. Camera about 20 degrees above the road, matching panel A's downward diorama view.

LIGHT, from panel A: deep night. A warm amber gas-lamp key from the VIEWER'S LEFT rakes the near flank of the carriage, the near wheels and the top of the horse and driver; everything else falls into deep Prussian-blue night shadow with a cool blue rim. The carriage's own lamp is a small hot amber point of light in its lamp bracket. No daylight, no white studio light, no coloured light on the background.

STYLE LAW, copy panel A exactly: stylized low-poly 3D game diorama render, matte flat-shaded chunky facets, clean simple shapes, soft ambient occlusion, NO outlines, NO texture grain, NO photographic detail, NO text, NO lettering, NO signage.

FRAMING AND CANVAS, copy panel C: the horse and carriage together are ONE subject alone in the middle of a completely flat solid magenta #FF00FF field, with clear empty magenta margin on all four sides - nothing cropped, nothing touching the edge. The wheels and the hooves rest on one common invisible ground line just above the bottom margin. NO ground, NO cast shadow, NO cobbles, NO street, NO buildings, NO fog, NO extra people beyond the driver on his box. Magenta everywhere the vehicle is not.
